# Frontend Public Assets - Instructions

## Purpose
Static files served directly at root path, not processed by build tool.

## File Structure
```
public/
├── favicon.ico                 # 32x32, 16x16 multi-size ICO
├── favicon.svg                 # SVG favicon for modern browsers
├── apple-touch-icon.png        # 180x180 for iOS
├── manifest.json               # PWA manifest
├── robots.txt                  # Search engine directives
├── sitemap.xml                 # SEO sitemap (generated)
├── browserconfig.xml           # Windows tile config
├── offline.html                # Offline fallback page
├── sw.js                       # Service worker (generated by Workbox)
├── images/
│   ├── og-default.png          # 1200x630 Open Graph default
│   ├── twitter-card.png        # 1200x600 Twitter card
│   └── logos/
│       ├── logo-192.png        # PWA icon 192x192
│       ├── logo-512.png        # PWA icon 512x512
│       └── maskable-512.png    # Maskable icon
└── locales/
    ├── en.json                 # English translations
    ├── hi.json                 # Hindi translations
    └── ...                     # Other languages
```

## File Details

### favicon.ico
- Multi-resolution: 16x16, 32x32, 48x48
- Generated from SVG source
- Placed at root for browser auto-detection

### favicon.svg
- Scalable vector favicon
- Supports `prefers-color-scheme` for dark mode
- `<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg">`

### apple-touch-icon.png
- 180x180 PNG for iOS home screen
- No transparency (iOS adds rounded corners)
- `<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">`

### manifest.json (PWA)
```json
{
  "name": "CodeNova - Dynamic Tour Planning",
  "short_name": "CodeNova",
  "description": "Personalized Dynamic Tour Planning & Operations Platform",
  "start_url": "/traveler/dashboard",
  "display": "standalone",
  "background_color": "#ffffff",
  "theme_color": "#3b82f6",
  "orientation": "portrait-primary",
  "icons": [
    { "src": "/images/logos/logo-192.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any" },
    { "src": "/images/logos/logo-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any" },
    { "src": "/images/logos/maskable-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "maskable" }
  ],
  "categories": ["travel", "productivity"],
  "shortcuts": [
    { "name": "Plan Trip", "url": "/traveler/plan", "description": "Plan a new trip" },
    { "name": "My Trips", "url": "/traveler/trips", "description": "View my trips" }
  ]
}
```

### robots.txt
```
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Disallow private/admin routes
Disallow: /operator/
Disallow: /vendor/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /auth/

Sitemap: https://codenova.com/sitemap.xml
```

### offline.html
- Served when Service Worker can't fetch
- Minimal HTML with inline CSS/JS
- Shows "You're offline" message
- Caches last known itinerary data
- Provides "Retry" button

### Service Worker (sw.js)
- Generated by `vite-plugin-pwa` / Workbox
- Strategies:
  - Static assets: CacheFirst
  - API calls: NetworkFirst with offline fallback
  - Images: CacheFirst with expiration
  - Fonts: CacheFirst
- Precaches: manifest, offline.html, critical CSS/JS
- Runtime caching for API responses
- Background sync for mutations

### Open Graph / Twitter Images
- `og-default.png`: 1200x630, branded, descriptive
- `twitter-card.png`: 1200x600, same content
- Used for social sharing of trips, itineraries

### Locale Files
- Static JSON for i18n
- Loaded dynamically based on user locale
- Structure: `{ "key": "translation" }`
- Nested keys with dot notation: `"common.save": "Save"`

## Build Integration
- Vite copies `public/` to `dist/` as-is
- No hashing for these files (stable URLs)
- Service worker references by exact path
- Manifest.json referenced in HTML head

## Key Constraints
- No build processing - files served exactly as-is
- Keep files small (< 50KB each)
- Version manifest.json when PWA features change
- Update offline.html when offline UX changes
- Test PWA installation on real devices
- Verify offline functionality regularly
